correctness.rationale: Outside-neighbor count for absent root edge uv is d_H(u)+d_H(v); fort iff no simultaneous degree-zero and degree-one root vertices. If every root covered, minimal fort is an inclusion-minimal edge cover, hence spanning star forest; if some isolate, every nonempty fort contains a cycle, and minimality forces precisely one cycle omitting at least one vertex. Count labeled stars via exponential formula and cycles via (k−1)!/2, with unique treatment of K_2 component. Independent direct line-graph fort and proper-subset tests for n=4,5,6 produce {2:3,3:8}, {3:40,4:20}, {3:35,4:195,5:78}. Infinite proof is independent of these finite checks.
